items.clause: 2.39, high rise building 24 m or above in height
items.paraphrase: A building of 24 m or more is high-rise whatever its use.
items.note: read 2026-11-15: dfes.goa.gov.in copy of the code part on fire and life safety (2026)

items.clause: 4.4.2.4.2 a) corridor not narrower than the exit doorways it serves; 4.4.2.4.1 b) exit doorway at least 1000 mm
items.paraphrase: An egress corridor is at least as wide as its exit doors, 1000 mm or more.
items.note: derived by the editor from two read clauses

items.clause: 4.4.2.4.3.1 riser at most 150 mm, other buildings
items.paraphrase: A stair in flats and offices rises at most 150 mm per step.
A residential stair tread is at least 250 mm.

items.clause: 4.4.2.4.3.4 h), handrails on external stairs 1000 to 1200 mm high
items.paraphrase: External stair handrails stand 1000 to 1200 mm high.
items.note: the clause is for external stairs; a general guard height in other code parts was not read

items.clause: doors in residential buildings, clear width at least 900 mm excluding frame and leaf
items.paraphrase: An accessible door gives 900 mm clear.

items.clause: 6.1 residential buildings, wheelchair turning diameter at least 1500 mm
items.paraphrase: A wheelchair needs a 1500 mm turning circle.

items.clause: 3.10 and table 3.4, ramp gradient not steeper than 1:12
items.paraphrase: A ramp is no steeper than 1 in 12.

items.note: na: the code uses a 24 m high-rise line and occupancy groups, no 13 m class
